Vela photographs are allowed only for items with a green permission card. Disable the flash. A yellow card does not grant photography permission.

sources.excerpt:
# Visit duration

A Vela archive visit lasts 75 minutes from the booked start time. Arriving late does not extend the end time.

sources.excerpt:
# Damage

If an Oriole sensor is damaged, stop using it and notify the Equipment steward through the incident form. Do not attempt a repair.
